HexKagune 1.0.34 for Forge 1.20.1 (clients need PlayerAnimator, bendy-lib and Photon). Install on client and server (protocol 48). Testing build.

- **Peace blades:** a little thicker, with a raised ridge and keen bevelled edges; same shapes and colours as before.
- **Peace yellow trails:** removed.
- **Z Crossblade Waltz:** needs a target within 10 blocks; all six blades go in one at a time and stay in, then tear out together in a spray of blood.
- **J Aegis of :Re:** three shield tendrils (over your head, left, right) for 15 s; they take every hit for you and swing to meet it.
- **J Aegis of :Re:** arrows and other shots bounce off back at the shooter; anything crowding you is shoved off unhurt.
- **J Aegis of :Re:** pushes you off lava, hauls you out if you fall in, and catches you on a shield before a fall lands.
- **G White Wing Ascent:** two tendrils plant on the ground and lift you 17 blocks; after 7.5 s they lower you gently.
- **G White Wing Ascent:** press G again in the air to be wrenched down into a superhero landing that tears 46 red flesh tendrils out of the ground within 30 blocks.
- **G White Wing Ascent:** every tendril is a different height, thickness and shape each time; they hurt whatever they burst through, then lash at hostiles for 6 s and sink back.
- **B Piercing Salvation (hold):** the blades join into one lance in front of you, longer and bigger up to 3 s of holding.
- **B Piercing Salvation (release):** the lance shoots out, impales the first body, drags it up to 30 blocks and pins it to a wall for 4 s; press B again to cancel.
- **B Piercing Salvation:** you can walk while it's out, but no other ability or M1 until it's back.
- **C Rebirth Instinct (hold):** the blades go into the ground; release for 2 creatures, 3 from 3.5 s, 4 at 7 s.
- **C Rebirth Instinct:** humanoid flesh creatures climb out of the ground in front of you, each in its own spot, follow you a few steps back and keep apart.
- **C Rebirth Instinct:** they grow arm blades and cut down hostiles near you (spreading over targets, each on its own rhythm), jump or path around when stuck, and melt into the ground after 15 s.
- **V The Final Horizon:** dash and a blade uppercut throws the target 12 blocks up, you rise under it, five blades go in one at a time from all sides, the great blade strikes it down.
- **V The Final Horizon:** on the ground the embedded blades drive it straight down through the blocks up to 12 deep, then tear out; the broken ground grows back.
- **Peace first-person animations:** not adapted yet (comes after you've tested the moves).
